description: This source file defines extension methods for the DocumentObject class hierarchy in the MigraDoc library. It provides functionality to retrieve elements, text, styles, and formatting information from various document components such as Paragraphs, Cells, Tables, Headers, Footers, etc., with recursive and filtering capabilities.

classes.name: ElementsExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for traversing and extracting information from DocumentObject hierarchy.

methods.name: GetElements
methods.description: Retrieves the child elements (like sections, rows, cells, etc.) from a DocumentObject, optionally including headers and footers.

methods.name: GetElements<T>
methods.description: Filters elements by a specific type T from the result of GetElements.

methods.name: GetElementsRecursively
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all descendant elements from a DocumentObject.

methods.name: GetElementsRecursively<T>
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all descendant elements of type T.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters a list of DocumentObject? to only elements of type T.

methods.name: GetText
methods.description: Extracts the combined text content from various document elements.

methods.name: GetStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the style name of a DocumentObject.

methods.name: GetFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the ParagraphFormat associated with a DocumentObject.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Retrieves the Font object associated with a DocumentObject.

methods.name: GetUsedFormatValue
methods.description: Gets a formatting value directly or via style inheritance, such as font size or spacing.
